name: White Violin
source:
The white violin. An instrument that hasn't been finished with a soul. A device that only resonates with certain beings. Join Luna as she finds out the mystery behind the white violin, the people in the castle, and her own self.

[From [url=https://purin-productions.itch.io/white-violin]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
白色的小提琴。一种尚未完成灵魂的乐器。一种只与某些存在产生共鸣的装置。和卢娜一起找出白色小提琴、城堡里的人们以及她自己背后的秘密。

[来自[url=https://purin-productions.itch.io/white-violin]Itch.io[/url]]
